summary.headline: Kraken snapshot 20260630 is Stage 0 attestation-model: quarterly accountant Merkle (LedgerLens / The Network Firm) plus CMS reserve ratios — no permissionless wallet ZIP or machine-verified attestation PDF.
summary.rationale: solvency-claim PASS means self-reported CMS reserve ratios ≥ 100% (capped stables treated as published 105%+ floor). LedgerLens exposes a full combined Merkle root and names The Network Firm LLP, but user leaf/path remains login-gated, wallet ownership evidence stays inside the accountant workflow, and third-party-attestation is not machine-parsed — Stage 1 stays out of reach by disclosure design.
